name: Marrakech, Morocco
description: An intoxicating sensory kaleidoscope within ancient terracotta ramparts. Maze-like souks filled with fragrant cumin and dried mint, tranquil riad courtyards shaded by orange trees, and vibrant storytelling in Jemaa el-Fnaa.
bestTimeToVisit: October to April for mild, sun-drenched afternoons and cool evenings
highlights: Navigating the spice labyrinth of Souk Semmarine
Finding oasis peace inside Le Jardin Secret
Traditional hammam ritual scented with black eucalyptus soap
Stargazing excursions into the nearby Agafay Stone Desert
